theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)) (G : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid (k + 1))) (w : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → ℤ) (c : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) → (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) → (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun u => (w i u : ℝ)) (A i)) → (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, 0 ≤ c i u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c i u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in A i, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w i u : ℝ)| * c i u) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in A i, (w i u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (T ω)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
